description: Which of these locations are reachable within N minutes from an origin by public transport (or driving/walking/cycling), and how long each takes. Filters candidate destinations by travel time. Example: traveltime_time_filter({ origin_lat: 51.5072, origin_lon: -0.1276, destinations: [{ id: "a", lat: 51.52, lon: -0.09 }, { id: "b", lat: 51.60, lon: -0.20 }], travel_time: 45, minutes: true, transport: "public_transport", departure_time: "2026-07-06T08:30:00Z", _apiKey: "appId:apiKey" })

_apiKey.description: TravelTime credentials as "appId:apiKey" from your traveltime.com account.

departure_time.description: ISO 8601 departure timestamp (e.g. "2026-07-06T08:30:00Z"). Public-transport searches need a timestamp; defaults to now if omitted.

destinations.description: Candidate destinations to test. Each: { id?, lat, lon }. Max 2000. IDs auto-generated ("dest_0", ...) if omitted.

minutes.description: If true, travel_time is interpreted as minutes and multiplied by 60.

transport.description: Transport mode (default "public_transport"). One of: driving, walking, cycling, public_transport, driving+public_transport.

travel_time.description: Max journey time. Seconds by default (default 1800 = 30 min). Set minutes:true to pass minutes. Max 14400s / 240 min.

name: traveltime_time_filter
title: Traveltime Time Filter
